== History ==
According to shrine history, in {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yōrō}} 1 ({{ill|717|ab|717|af|717|am|717 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|717|ar|717|ary|717|ast|717|avk|717|az|717|azb|۷۱۷ (میلادی)|be|717|be_x_old|717|bg|717|bn|৭১৭|bpy|মারি ৭১৭|br|717|bs|717.|ca|717|cdo|717 nièng|ceb|717|ckb|٧١٧|crh|717|cs|717|cv|717|cy|717|da|717|de|717|el|717|eml|717|eo|717|es|717|et|717|eu|717|fa|۷۱۷ (میلادی)|fi|717|fo|717|fr|717|fy|717|ga|717|gan|717年|gd|717|gl|717|hak|717-ngièn|he|717|hi|717|hr|717.|ht|717 (almanak jilyen)|hu|717|hy|717|id|717|ilo|717|io|717|is|717|it|717|ja|717年|jv|717|ka|717|kaa|717|kk|717 жыл|ko|717년|la|717|lb|717|lij|717|lmo|717|lt|717 m.|lv|717. gads|map_bms|717|mdf|717|mg|717|mhr|717|mk|717|mr|इ.स. ७१७|mrj|717 и|ms|717|mzn|۷۱۷|nah|717|nap|717|nds|717|new|सन् ७१७|nl|717|nn|717|no|717|nrm|717|nso|717|oc|717|or|୭୧୭|os|717-æм аз|pl|717|pnb|717|pt|717|qu|717|ro|717|ru|717 год|rue|717|sa|७१७|scn|717|sd|717ع|sh|717.|shn|717|si|717|sk|717|sl|717|smn|717|sq|717|sr|717|su|717|sv|717|sw|717|tg|Соли 717|th|พ.ศ. 1260|tk|717|tl|717|tly|717|tr|717|tt|717 ел|uk|717|ur|717ء|uz|717|vec|717|vi|717|vls|717|war|717|wuu|717年|xmf|717|zh|717年|zh_min_nan|717 nî|zh_yue|717年|qid=Q23532}}), in March, monk {{ill|Taichō|de|Taichō|fr|Taichō|it|Taichō|ja|泰澄|qid=Q2388439}} set out from Asōzu intending to ascend {{ill|Mount Haku|arz|جبل مونت هاكو|az|Haku dağı|bcl|Bukid nin Haku|ceb|Haku-san (bukid sa Hapon, lat 36,16, long 136,77)|cs|Hakusan (sopka)|de|Haku-san|es|Monte Haku|eu|Haku mendia|fa|کوه هاکو|fr|Mont Haku|hu|Haku-hegy|id|Gunung Haku|it|Monte Haku|ja|白山|ka|ჰაკუსანი|ko|하쿠산|mk|Планина Хаку|ml|ഹകു പർവതം|ms|Gunung Haku|my|ဟခုတောင်|nl|Hakusan (berg)|pnb|ٹلہ ہاکو|ru|Хакусан (гора)|sk|Hakusan (sopka)|sl|Haku (gora)|tr|Haku Dağı|uk|Хаку (гора)|uz|Haku togʻi|vi|Núi Haku|zh|白山 (兩白山地)|qid=Q2639098}} and, upon arriving in Ōno, stayed for about ten days at a place south of the shrine where clear spring water flowed from woodland. This is an excellent woodland-spring place where I always delight my heart and descend to wander.” A shrine was then established, which is taken as the origin of enshrinement. In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}, it is listed as one of the nine shrines of {{ill|Ōno District, Fukui|ja|大野郡 (福井県)|zh|大野郡 (福井縣)|qid=Q8081656|lt=Ōno District}}, {{ill|Echizen Province|ceb|Echizen|cs|Provincie Ečizen|de|Provinz Echizen|es|Provincia de Echizen|fa|ولایت اچیزن|fr|Province d'Echizen|gl|Provincia de Echizen|id|Provinsi Echizen|it|Echizen (provincia)|ja|越前国|ko|에치젠국|lt|Ečidzeno žemė|nl|Echizen (provincie)|pt|Província de Echizen|ru|Этидзэн (провинция)|simple|Echizen Province|sk|Ečizen (provincia)|sr|Провинција Ечизен|tr|Echizen (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Етідзен|zh|越前國|zh_min_nan|Etizen-kok|zh_yue|越前國|qid=Q1047144}}, and ranked as a small shrine.

{{ill|Ifuriyama|ja|飯降山|lld|Ifuriyama|qid=Q11666745}}, rising behind the shrine, is also called “Otake-san” and is regarded as an ancient {{ill|Sacred mountains|ar|جبال مقدسة|ca|Muntanyes sagrades|de|Heiliger Berg|es|Montaña sagrada|fa|کوه‌های مقدس|fi|Pyhä vuori|fr|Montagne sacrée|id|Gunung keramat|ja|神体山|lt|Alkakalnis|lv|Svētie kalni|pl|Święte góry|ru|Священная гора|sq|Malet e shenjta|uk|Священна гора|vi|Núi thiêng|qid=Q1595289}}. On the {{ill|Chunfen|af|Chunfen|cdo|Chŭng-hŭng|hak|Chhûn-fûn|id|Chunfen|ja|春分|ko|춘분|sv|Chunfen|vi|Xuân phân|wuu|春分|za|Cinfaen|zh|春分|zh_classical|春分|zh_min_nan|Chhun-hun|zh_yue|春分|qid=Q1339268}} and {{ill|Qiufen|af|Qiufen|cdo|Chiŭ-hŭng|hak|Chhiû-fûn|ja|秋分|ko|추분|sv|Qiufen|vi|Thu phân|wuu|秋分|za|Coufaen|zh|秋分|zh_classical|秋分|zh_min_nan|Chhiu-hun|zh_yue|秋分|qid=Q1200436}}, the sun sets at the summit on the extension line of the torii and shrine building.

== Access ==
*15 minutes on foot south from {{ill|Echizen-Ōno Station|ja|越前大野駅|ko|에치젠오노역|my|အဲချိဇင်း − အိုးနိုဘူတာ|ur|ایچیزین-اونو اسٹیشن|zh|越前大野站|qid=Q2815910}} on the {{ill|Etsumi-Hoku Line|de|Kuzuryūko-Linie|fr|Ligne Etsumi-Hoku|it|Linea Etsumi-Hoku|ja|越美北線|ko|에쓰미호쿠선|zh|越美北線|qid=Q5357982}} of {{ill|West Japan Railway Company|arz|شركة سكك حديد غرب اليابان|azb|باتی ژاپون دمیریول‌لاری|ca|Companyia de Ferrocarrils del Japó Occidental|cs|JR West|da|West Japan Railway Company|de|West Japan Railway Company|eo|JR Okcidenta|es|West Japan Railway Company|fa|شرکت راه‌آهن غرب ژاپن|fi|JR Nishi-Nihon|fr|West Japan Railway Company|hu|West Japan Railway Company|id|Perusahaan Kereta Api Jepang Barat|it|West Japan Railway Company|ja|西日本旅客鉄道|jv|West Japan Railway Company|ko|서일본 여객철도|ms|Syarikat Kereta Api Jepun Barat|my|အနောက်ဂျပန်မီးရထားကုမ္ပဏီ|nds|JR Westjapan|nl|West Japan Railway Company|no|JR Nishi Nihon|pl|West Japan Railway Company|pt|West Japan Railway Company|ru|West Japan Railway Company|sv|JR Nishi Nihon|th|บริษัทรถไฟญี่ปุ่นตะวันตก|tl|West Japan Railway Company|tr|West Japan Railway Company|uk|West Japan Railway Company|ur|ویسٹ جاپان ریلوے کمپنی|wuu|西日本旅客铁道|zh|西日本旅客鐵道|zh_min_nan|Se Ji̍t-pún Lú-kheh Thih-tō|zh_yue|西日本旅客鐵道|qid=Q502125}}.
*From Echizen-Ōno Station, get off at the “Shinokura Shrine Sandō-guchi” stop on {{ill|Ōno municipal bus #Blue Bus|ja|大野市営バス|qid=Q108060249}}, then immediate walk.
*From {{ill|Fukui Station (Fukui)|eo|Stacio Fukui (Fukui)|fr|Gare de Fukui|it|Stazione di Fukui (Fukui)|ja|福井駅 (福井県)|ko|후쿠이역 (후쿠이현)|ms|Stesen Fukui (Fukui)|my|ဖုခုအိဘူတာ (ဖုခုအိ)|ur|فوکوئی اسٹیشن (فوکوئی)|zh|福井車站 (福井縣)|qid=Q867992|lt=Fukui Station}} or {{ill|Katsuyama Station|ja|勝山駅|my|ခဆွတ်ယာမဘူတာ|ur|کاتسویاما اسٹیشن|zh|勝山站|qid=Q11400269}}, take {{ill|Keifuku Bus|ff|Keifuku Bus|ja|京福バス|qid=Q6383575}} and get off at “Vio,” then 5 minutes on foot east.
